sample_scope: Route-disjoint against declared sources only; scene overlap allowed; checkpoint trained on R2R train.
sampling_001: Invalid: 12/96 overlap; retained pilot and excluded from sampling_002.
historical_protocol_reference: Frozen capture/critical configs refer to strict scene-independent protocol; the implemented population differs and is explicitly superseded by GRAPH_VALUE_ROUTE_INTERVENTION_PROTOCOL.md for this exploratory study.
ranker_fit_source: critical_graph_value_fresh/full_002 only; target labels not used in fit or schedule code.
deprecated_schedule: schedule_ranker_001.json never executed; generated with earlier script, superseded by audited schedule_ranker_002.json.
logging_limitation: Native foundation and intervention cycles have separate durable stdout/stderr. Critical smoke/full001 were launched through terminal without separate full stdout/stderr archives; native running logs, per-case primitive traces, manifests and results remain available. Do not claim complete stderr archival for those two runs.
probe_scope: 9,740 complete single-option executions, not 9,740 full-episode continuations. Only critical full001 has 561 native action-to-STOP cases.
legacy_harness_flags: run_single_intervention and hook still use legacy analysis_only_oracle/privileged flags. Schedules identify non-oracle learned/random action choice; audit summary uses schedule metadata. This is an offline replay harness, not a released online model.
census_interpretation: Overlapping rescue opportunities, not disjoint causal failure classes. Critical timing is retrospective; later unrecoverable states do not imply lack of earlier ranking rescue.
collision_metric: Native collision normalization can exceed one; it is not a probability. Use primitive collision-event count for causal comparisons.
